study.question: Can shared sufficient-count execution plus action-only identity/context recurrence retain direct_lifted utility while reducing measured training or end-to-end inference cost? Does semantic action grouping outperform an equally compressed mixed action/age partition?
study.hypothesis: Observation: selected_exact AUC=0.6304723985, logloss=0.1927572573, train=631.46s, inference=22.8716s versus frozen_direct AUC=0.6303858902, train=681.28s, inference=25.4310s. The action_pooled transition replacement gave AUC=0.6303374903, train=628.65s and inference=22.9925s; rotated_pooled gave AUC=0.6302217596 and inference=21.9861s. Thus execution pruning helped in one-seed receipts, whereas changing transition states did not establish additional cost benefit or semantic superiority. Source inspection identifies six statistical sorts per selected parent (three identity, one joint-context, one conditional-repeat, one overlap), including redundant pair/group and pair/group/context counts. Hypothesis: one shared pair/group run table can reproduce the selected summaries with three sorts; then compressing identity/context recurrence from 16 action/age contexts to four action contexts may further reduce the overlap Gram computation and repeat statistics without consequential utility loss, since age remains available in the other branches. This is an untested representation hypothesis, not a measured result. No profile yet proves these operations dominate runtime.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local parent. Shared_full changes execution only; action_context additionally removes age resolution specifically from identity-context dependence, conditional identity repeat, and cross-context identity overlap. Transition target-match states remain full. This differs from the previous action_pooled transition-state replacement.

Previous four-action compression altered chronological transition states, not the identity/context contingency. Its small utility change and absent extra speed motivate moving the intervention rather than claiming it succeeded.

Inherits embedding/MLP and historical pooling background. DIN learns unnormalized target-conditioned activation weights; this candidate retains inherited deterministic target-match partitions and replaces a statistical contingency resolution. The supplied DIN-style baseline uses normalized attention and is an adaptation, not an exact DIN reproduction. No global novelty claim is made.

Author README confirms category, brand and behavior-type histories without items. No item identity, longer history, or DMR auxiliary target is invented. Publisher full text is unavailable in this authorized source; detailed DMR mechanism comparison remains unverified.

inherited_components: All selected_exact source and parameters, fixed target-match pooling, count statistics, histogram, independent moments and norm-collapsed field contrasts.

Joint bucket-pair identity and context statistics; conditional repetition; cross-context identity overlap; chronological full-state product transitions; pooled observed direct/lifted elapsed-gap branch.
Fixed feature scale log(129), complete-category/brand eligibility for identity summaries, zero-safe denominators, missing/padding handling and original scratch initialization order.
Original optimizer, learning rate, binary loss, checkpoint selection, full population, causal histories and host validation/timing interfaces.
study.proposed_difference: Execution: sort packed pair/group once, build per-run context counts [B,L,K], reuse them for H(X), H(X,Y), conditional H(X|Y), collisions and groupwise context Gram matrices; retain the two category/brand marginal sorts. Full K=16 is an execution control. Candidate K=4 uses action_index; replacement control K=4 uses (action_index+coarse_age_bin)%4. Compression occurs before entropy, normalization and Gram computation. Context head remains 28 inputs. Repeat [group,4,3] lifts to [group,16,3] by the fixed balanced context map with factor 1/2. Cross-context Gram retains six off-diagonal coarse pairs per target group: each appears in 16 corresponding fine-context pairs with factor 1/4; same-coarse-state pairs are zero. This is an isometry from 24 intrinsic overlap coordinates to the original 480 inputs, and from 48 repeat coordinates to 192. Both compressed arms allocate exactly the original 17,253,123 total / 174,435 dense parameters; smaller effective input rank remains an intended difference. All other branches and initialized parameters are unchanged. No trained weights or cached labels enter construction. Shared_full is execution engineering; action_context is a mechanism-distinct information replacement with unverified priority.
predictions: Gate: shared_full identity/context/repeat/overlap features and same-checkpoint parent logits match the selected implementation within max absolute error 1e-5 on bounded host probes; independent dense oracles agree to 1e-5. Count conservation, padding/permutation, empty/missing support and norm-lift checks pass. Any violation blocks interpretation of execution equivalence.

Predeclared utility retention: paired mean AUC(candidate)-AUC(reference)>=-0.0003 and paired mean logloss(candidate)-logloss(reference)<=0.0001, against both shared_full and contemporaneous selected_reference. Historical direct_lifted/frozen_direct are utility anchors, not substitute timing repetitions. One seed only screens this threshold; final support requires three paired seeds and user-cluster paired intervals if the authorized host can supply them. For a supported noninferiority statement, also require the paired user-cluster 95% lower AUC-difference bound >=-0.0003 and upper logloss-difference bound <=0.0001 when authorized intervals are available. If bounds cross either margin, or intervals are unavailable, retain the result as preliminary even when paired means pass.

Predeclared useful efficiency: at least 5% reduction in mean measured training seconds OR end-to-end validation inference seconds versus selected_reference, reproducible in final paired-seed receipts with the same timing boundary, alongside the utility guardrail. Report both timing endpoints, wall time, parameters, peak GPU memory, examples/s and p50/p95 batch latency. Do not infer speed from tensor dimensions. Incremental compression efficiency requires the same criterion against shared_full; otherwise credit shared execution only.

Mechanism discrimination: action_context may retain utility better than rotated_context at the same widths/cost. Require paired-seed mean AUC advantage at least 0.0001 and a paired user-cluster 95% interval above zero if available before calling semantic alignment supported; otherwise remain unresolved. Repeated seeds are repetitions, not new mechanism contrasts.

Age-changing diagnostic preserves action_context statistical summaries but can change full/rotated summaries. This demonstrates the implemented information boundary only, not predictive sufficiency. Explore host-provided fixed history-length, hour, behavior and user-frequency slices with sample/positive/negative counts; insufficient slices remain inconclusive.
falsifiers: Shared_full feature/logit discrepancy >1e-5, failure of independent count/statistic oracles, or failed zero/padding/ordering/missing checks invalidates the corresponding implementation claim; retain failure receipt and charge correction/retry.
AUC loss exceeds 0.0003 or logloss increase exceeds 0.0001 versus either closest reference after repetition: compression does not retain utility under the declared criterion, even if it is faster.

No reproducible >=5% training or inference reduction under identical measurements: no established efficiency benefit. A change in parameter count or theoretical operation count alone cannot rescue the claim.

Compression beats selected_reference but not shared_full on cost: attribute speed only to execution reuse. Rotated matches/beats action: semantic superiority is unsupported, not proof that action is useless.

Insufficient resources or missing paired uncertainty/timing repetitions limits conclusions to preliminary observations; unavailable pooled_observed/sketch256 receipts prevent a frontier claim relative to those named controls.
alternative_explanations: One-seed drift, changed floating reduction order, nondeterministic kernels, checkpoint choice and system timing noise explain small utility or timing differences.
Compression reduces effective feature rank even while allocated capacity and RNG are fixed; both action and rotated replacements may act through regularization rather than semantics.

Changing context resolution jointly changes H(X,Y), H(X|Y) and overlap normalization. This grouped replacement cannot identify a single mediating head; any positive direction needs a later branch-specific replacement before that claim.

The fixed balanced lifts preserve norm and allocation, not individual random projection orientation or optimization trajectory; same initialized function follows from zero final residual weights, not equivalent subsequent learning.
Sharing counts changes entropy floating reductions. Full-mode numerical agreement is necessary but does not guarantee identical trained checkpoints.
Unmeasured sorting, feature gathering, embedding/Adam updates or launch overhead may dominate; smaller Gram dimensions may not produce end-to-end savings.
Static publisher snapshot as-of dates are undocumented; benchmark validity is not a production point-in-time guarantee. No withheld scores are available.

Selection and continued research reuse the same authorized validation population; paired seeds and user-cluster intervals do not remove selection optimism or establish independent holdout generalization. No test or closed archive is consulted.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: g2-r0024-selected_exact wall=736.72s, train=631.46s; g2-r0024-frozen_direct wall=795.17s; frozen estimated unit=704.37s and per-trial cap=1760.93s. Entry remaining budget=16858.21s, including preparation; no execution was launched locally.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Allocate at most 4000s nominal (4 variants x1000s) for this suite, with failures, controls and diagnostics charged. Reserve 3000s for at most one discriminating branch-specific follow-up or a correction; do not expand by default. If actual costs approach the 1760.93s cap, remove optional follow-ups and recalculate before another call.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 6000s for six additional runs (seeds43,44 for retained candidate, shared_full, and the closest necessary semantic/full control) after using valid seed42 receipts, targeting three paired seeds. Freeze source/config/checkpoint hashes, chosen suite and commands using validation only before final repetitions. Retain selected_reference and frozen_direct imported comparisons. If three final models cannot fit, prioritize candidate and shared_full paired seeds, explicitly omit semantic attribution and report limitations. No test execution or holdout feedback is authorized.
cost_plan.stop_rule: This phase only writes modules and proposal; host controls all training and ledger updates. Never raise any cap, install packages, or duplicate an uncertain execution. Stop expansion if remaining budget cannot fund complete next unit plus final reserve; stop on user instruction, hard limit or integrity failure. Missing pooled_observed and sketch256 sources/receipts were searched with no authorized hits; keep the frontier question unresolved and request authorized imports in a later phase, never fabricate them.
